requirement.description: The Flask hook implementation fails to properly detect and instrument Flask applications in test environments. The hook is not correctly identifying Flask app instances created within test modules and therefore doesn't instrument the view functions and error handlers that should be tracked for HTTP requests.
requirement.contract: When a Flask application is created within a test module (like in tests/test_server_hook_flask.py), the hook_flask function must properly detect the Flask app instance and instrument all associated view functions and error handlers so that HTTP requests to those endpoints are correctly tracked with their route labels (e.g., "@app.route('/')") instead of client request labels (e.g., "requests.get(...)"

requirement.description: The generic hook mechanism has insufficient detection logic for Flask applications created in test modules. It fails to properly identify Flask app instances that are dynamically created within test modules rather than imported from external modules.
requirement.contract: The hook_generic function must properly detect Flask app instances regardless of whether they are imported from modules or created dynamically within test modules. It should identify Flask apps by checking for Flask-specific attributes (route, view_functions, error_handlers) and hook all associated view functions and error handlers.
